claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'PSR-550' printed on the control panel.
The witness did not see the LCD screen powered on or hear the audio quality.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may be faded, have lines, or be completely dead (common in this model).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the LCD screen while the unit is powered on.

risks.risk: Individual keys or control buttons may be unresponsive due to dirt or wear.
risks.proof: A video clip of a hand playing a chromatic scale across all 61 keys.

risks.risk: The internal speakers may be blown or the output ports may be damaged.
risks.proof: A video with sound showing the keyboard playing through its own speakers.

proof_requests: Photo of the LCD screen powered on showing the main menu.
Video of all keys being played to confirm they trigger sound.
Photo of the rear panel showing the power and output ports.
response.reason: The model is confirmed as a Yamaha PSR-550. Due to the significant yellowing and heavy wear reported, it must be priced at its worst functional case until power and audio are proven.
